segments.source: Orthogonal Complements
Understand the basic properties of orthogonal complements.
Learn to compute the orthogonal complement of a subspace.
Recipes: shortcuts for computing the orthogonal complements of common subspaces.
segments.translation: 계산법: 자주 쓰이는 부분공간의 직교여공간을 계산하는 지름길입니다.

segments.source: Picture: orthogonal complements in \R^2 and \R^3.
Theorem: row rank equals column rank.
Vocabulary words: orthogonal complement, row space.
It will be important to compute the set of all vectors that are orthogonal to a given set of vectors.
segments.translation: 주어진 벡터들의 집합에 직교하는 모든 벡터의 집합을 계산하는 일이 중요해질 것입니다.

segments.source: It turns out that a vector is orthogonal to a set of vectors if and only if it is orthogonal to the span of those vectors, which is a subspace, so we restrict ourselves to the case of subspaces.
segments.translation: 어떤 벡터가 벡터들의 집합에 직교하는 것은 그 벡터들의 생성(span)에 직교하는 것과 동치이며 이 생성은 부분공간이므로, 부분공간인 경우만 다루겠습니다.

segments.source: Definition of the Orthogonal Complement
Taking the orthogonal complement is an operation that is performed on subspaces.
segments.translation: 직교여공간을 취하는 것은 부분공간에 대해 수행하는 연산입니다.

segments.source: Orthogonal complement of a subspace
Let <m>W</m> be a subspace of <m>\R^n</m>.

Its <term>orthogonal complement</term> is the subspace
        <me>
          W^\perp = \bigl\{ \text{$v$ in $\R^n$}\mid
          v\cdot w=0 \text{ for all $w$ in $W$} \bigr\}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
W의 <term>직교여공간</term>은 다음 부분공간입니다. <me>
          W^\perp = \bigl\{ \text{$v$ in $\R^n$}\mid
          v\cdot w=0 \text{ for all $w$ in $W$} \bigr\}.
        </me>

segments.source: The symbol <m>W^\perp</m> is sometimes read <q><m>W</m> perp.</q>
This is the set of all vectors <m>v</m> in <m>\R^n</m> that are orthogonal to all of the vectors in <m>W</m>.
segments.translation: 이것은 <m>\R^n</m>의 벡터 <m>v</m> 중에서 <m>W</m>의 모든 벡터에 직교하는 것 전체의 집합입니다.

segments.source: We will show <xref ref="orthocomp-facts-basic">below</xref> that <m>W^\perp</m> is indeed a subspace.

We now have two similar-looking pieces of notation:
      <me>
        \begin{split}
        A^{\color{red}T} \amp\text{ is the transpose of a matrix $A$}. \\
        W^{\color{red}\perp} \amp\text{ is the orthogonal complement of a subspace $W$}.
        \end{split}
      </me>
      Try not to confuse the two.

segments.source: We see in the above pictures that <m>(W^\perp)^\perp = W</m>.
segments.translation: 위 그림들에서 <m>(W^\perp)^\perp = W</m>임을 알 수 있습니다.

segments.source: The orthogonal complement of <m>\R^n</m> is <m>\{0\}</m>, since the zero vector is the only vector that is orthogonal to all of the vectors in <m>\R^n</m>.
segments.translation: 영벡터는 <m>\R^n</m>의 모든 벡터에 직교하는 유일한 벡터이므로, <m>\R^n</m>의 직교여공간은 <m>\{0\}</m>입니다.

segments.source: For the same reason, we have <m>\{0\}^\perp = \R^n</m>.
Computing Orthogonal Complements
Since any subspace is a span, the following proposition gives a recipe for computing the orthogonal complement of any subspace.
segments.translation: 모든 부분공간은 생성(span)이므로, 다음 명제는 임의의 부분공간의 직교여공간을 구하는 계산 절차를 제공합니다.

segments.source: However, below we will give several shortcuts for computing the orthogonal complements of other common kinds of subspaces<ndash/>in particular, null spaces.
segments.translation: 그러나 아래에서는 다른 흔한 종류의 부분공간<ndash/>특히 영공간의 직교여공간을 구하는 몇 가지 지름길을 제시하겠습니다.

segments.source: To compute the orthogonal complement of a general subspace, usually it is best to rewrite the subspace as the column space or null space of a matrix, as in this <xref ref="subspace-is-col-or-nul"/>.
segments.translation: 일반적인 부분공간의 직교여공간을 구하려면, 이 <xref ref="subspace-is-col-or-nul"/>에서처럼 그 부분공간을 행렬의 열공간이나 영공간으로 다시 쓰는 것이 대개 가장 좋습니다.

segments.source: The orthogonal complement of a column space
Let <m>A</m> be a matrix and let <m>W=\Col(A)</m>.

Then
	<me>
	W^\perp = \Nul(A^T).
	</me>
To justify the first equality, we need to show that a vector <m>x</m> is perpendicular to the all of the vectors in <m>W</m> if and only if it is perpendicular only to <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m</m>.
segments.translation: 첫 번째 등식을 정당화하려면, 벡터 <m>x</m>가 <m>W</m>의 모든 벡터에 수직일 필요충분조건이 <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m</m>에만 수직인 것임을 보여야 합니다.

segments.source: Since the <m>v_i</m> are contained in <m>W</m>, we really only have to show that if <m>x\cdot v_1 = x\cdot v_2 = \cdots = x\cdot v_m = 0</m>, then <m>x</m> is perpendicular to every vector <m>v</m> in <m>W</m>.
segments.translation: <m>v_i</m>는 <m>W</m>에 포함되므로, 실제로는 <m>x\cdot v_1 = x\cdot v_2 = \cdots = x\cdot v_m = 0</m>이면 <m>x</m>가 <m>W</m>의 모든 벡터 <m>v</m>에 수직임만 보이면 됩니다.

segments.source:
Indeed, any vector in <m>W</m> has the form <m>v = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m</m> for suitable scalars <m>c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_m</m>, so
        <me>
          \begin{split}
          x\cdot v \amp= x\cdot(c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m) \\
          \amp= c_1(x\cdot v_1) + c_2(x\cdot v_2) + \cdots + c_m(x\cdot v_m) \\
          \amp= c_1(0) + c_2(0) + \cdots + c_m(0) = 0.
          \end{split}
        </me>
        Therefore, <m>x</m> is in <m>W^\perp.</m>
segments.translation:
실제로 <m>W</m>의 임의의 벡터는 적절한 스칼라 <m>c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_m</m>에 대해 <m>v = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m</m> 꼴이므로 <me>
          \begin{split}
          x\cdot v \amp= x\cdot(c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m) \\
          \amp= c_1(x\cdot v_1) + c_2(x\cdot v_2) + \cdots + c_m(x\cdot v_m) \\
          \amp= c_1(0) + c_2(0) + \cdots + c_m(0) = 0.
          \end{split}
        </me> 따라서 <m>x</m>는 <m>W^\perp.</m>에 속합니다.

segments.source:
By the <xref ref="matrixeq-row-column-prod">row-column rule for matrix multiplication</xref>, for any vector <m>x</m> in <m>\R^n</m> we have
        <me>
          Ax = \vec{v_1^Tx v_2^Tx \vdots, v_m^Tx}
          = \vec{v_1\cdot x v_2\cdot x \vdots, v_m\cdot x}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
<xref ref="matrixeq-row-column-prod">행렬 곱셈의 행-열 규칙</xref>에 의해, <m>\R^n</m>의 임의의 벡터 <m>x</m>에 대해 다음이 성립합니다. <me>
          Ax = \vec{v_1^Tx v_2^Tx \vdots, v_m^Tx}
          = \vec{v_1\cdot x v_2\cdot x \vdots, v_m\cdot x}.
        </me>

segments.source: Therefore, <m>x</m> is in <m>\Nul(A)</m> if and only if <m>x</m> is perpendicular to each vector <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m</m>.
segments.translation: 따라서 <m>x</m>가 <m>\Nul(A)</m>에 속할 필요충분조건은 <m>x</m>가 각 벡터 <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m</m>에 수직인 것입니다.

segments.source:
<idx><h>Orthogonal complement</h><h>of a span</h></idx>
    <idx><h>Span</h><h>orthogonal complement of</h></idx>
        Since column spaces are the same as spans, we can rephrase the proposition as follows.
segments.translation: <idx><h>Orthogonal complement</h><h>of a span</h></idx> <idx><h>Span</h><h>orthogonal complement of</h></idx> 열공간은 생성과 같으므로, 열공간의 직교여공간에 관한 명제를 다음과 같이 바꾸어 말할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Let <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m</m> be vectors in <m>\R^n</m>, and let <m>W = \Span\{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m\}</m>.
Again, it is important to be able to go easily back and forth between spans and column spaces.
segments.translation: 다시 말하지만, 생성과 열공간 사이를 쉽게 오갈 수 있는 것이 중요합니다.

segments.source: If you are handed a span, you can apply the proposition once you have rewritten your span as a column space.
segments.translation: 생성이 주어지면, 그 생성을 열공간으로 다시 쓴 뒤에 명제를 적용할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Orthogonal complementsystem of linear equations By the proposition, computing the orthogonal complement of a span means solving a system of linear equations.
segments.translation: Orthogonal complementsystem of linear equations 명제에 의해, 생성의 직교여공간을 구하는 것은 연립일차방정식을 푸는 것을 의미합니다.

segments.source:
For example, if
    <me>
      v_1 = \vec{1 7 2} \qquad v_2 = \vec{-2 3 1}
    </me>
    then <m>\Span\{v_1,v_2\}^\perp</m> is the solution set of the homogeneous linear system associated to the matrix
    <me>
      \mat{\matrow{v_1^T}; \matrow{v_2^T}} = \mat{1 7 2; -2 3 1}.
    </me>
segments.translation:
예를 들어 <me>
      v_1 = \vec{1 7 2} \qquad v_2 = \vec{-2 3 1}
    </me> 이면, <m>\Span\{v_1,v_2\}^\perp</m>는 다음 행렬에 대응하는 동차 연립일차방정식의 해집합입니다. <me>
      \mat{\matrow{v_1^T}; \matrow{v_2^T}} = \mat{1 7 2; -2 3 1}.
    </me>

segments.source:
This is the solution set of the system of equations
    <me>
      \syseq{x_1 + 7x_2 + 2x_3 = 0; -2x_1 + 3x_2 + x_3 = 0\rlap.}
    </me>

Compute <m>W^\perp</m>, where
        <me>
          W = \Span\left\{\vec{1 7 2},\;\vec{-2 3 1}\right\}.
        </me>

According to the <xref ref="orthocomp-comp-of-span"/>, we need to compute the null space of the matrix
        <me>
          \mat{1 7 2; -2 3 1} \;\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\;
          \mat{1 0 -1/17; 0 1 5/17}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
<xref ref="orthocomp-comp-of-span"/>에 따르면, 다음 행렬의 영공간을 구해야 합니다. <me>
          \mat{1 7 2; -2 3 1} \;\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\;
          \mat{1 0 -1/17; 0 1 5/17}.
        </me>

segments.source:
The free variable is <m>x_3</m>, so the parametric form of the solution set is <m>x_1=x_3/17,\,x_2=-5x_3/17</m>, and the parametric vector form is
        <me>
          \vec{x_1 x_2 x_3} = x_3\vec{1/17 -5/17 1}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
자유변수는 <m>x_3</m>이므로 해집합의 매개변수 꼴은 <m>x_1=x_3/17,\,x_2=-5x_3/17</m>이고, 매개변수 벡터 꼴은 다음과 같습니다. <me>
          \vec{x_1 x_2 x_3} = x_3\vec{1/17 -5/17 1}.
        </me>

segments.source:
Scaling by a factor of <m>17</m>, we see that
        <me>
          W^\perp = \Span\left\{\vec{1 -5 17}\right\}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
<m>17</m>을 곱해 크기를 조정하면 다음을 알 수 있습니다. <me>
          W^\perp = \Span\left\{\vec{1 -5 17}\right\}.
        </me>

segments.source:
We can check our work:
        <me>
          \vec{1 7 2}\cdot\vec{1 -5 17} = 0 \qquad
          \vec{-2 3 1}\cdot\vec{1 -5 17} = 0.
        </me>
segments.translation:
계산 결과를 다음과 같이 확인할 수 있습니다. <me>
          \vec{1 7 2}\cdot\vec{1 -5 17} = 0 \qquad
          \vec{-2 3 1}\cdot\vec{1 -5 17} = 0.
        </me>

segments.source: Find all vectors orthogonal to <m>v = \vec{1 1 -1}.</m>

According to the <xref ref="orthocomp-comp-of-span"/>, we need to compute the null space of the matrix
        <me>A = \mat{\matrow{v}} = \mat{1 1 -1}.</me>
segments.translation: <xref ref="orthocomp-comp-of-span"/>에 따라, 다음 행렬의 영공간을 계산해야 합니다. <me>A = \mat{\matrow{v}} = \mat{1 1 -1}.</me>

segments.source: This matrix is in reduced-row echelon form.

The parametric form for the solution set is <m>x_1 = -x_2 + x_3</m>, so the parametric vector form of the general solution is
        <me>x = \vec{x_1 x_2 x_3} = x_2\vec{-1 1 0} + x_3\vec{1 0 1}.</me>
segments.translation: 해집합의 매개변수 꼴은 <m>x_1 = -x_2 + x_3</m>이므로, 일반해의 매개변수 벡터 꼴은 다음과 같습니다. <me>x = \vec{x_1 x_2 x_3} = x_2\vec{-1 1 0} + x_3\vec{1 0 1}.</me>

segments.source: Therefore, the answer is the plane \Span\left\{\vec{-1 1 0},\;\vec{1 0 1}\right\}.
The set of all vectors perpendicular to <m>v</m>.

Compute
        <me>
          \Span\left\{\vec{1 1 -1},\;\vec{1 1 1}\right\}^\perp.
        </me>

According to the <xref ref="orthocomp-comp-of-span"/>, we need to compute the null space of the matrix
        <me>A = \mat{1 1 -1; 1 1 1}\;\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\;\mat{1 1 0; 0 0 1}.</me>
segments.translation: <xref ref="orthocomp-comp-of-span"/>에 따라, 다음 행렬의 영공간을 계산해야 합니다. <me>A = \mat{1 1 -1; 1 1 1}\;\xrightarrow{\text{RREF}}\;\mat{1 1 0; 0 0 1}.</me>

segments.source:
The parametric vector form of the solution is
        <me>\vec{x_1 x_2 x_3} = x_2\vec{-1 1 0}.</me>
segments.translation: 해의 매개변수 벡터 꼴은 다음과 같습니다. <me>\vec{x_1 x_2 x_3} = x_2\vec{-1 1 0}.</me>

segments.source: Therefore, the answer is the line \Span\left\{\vec{-1 1 0}\right\}.
The orthogonal complement of the plane spanned by <m>v = (1,1,-1)</m> and <m>w = (1, 1, 1)</m>.
In order to find shortcuts for computing orthogonal complements, we need the following basic facts.
segments.translation: 직교여공간을 계산하는 지름길을 찾으려면 다음과 같은 기본적인 사실들이 필요합니다.

segments.source: Looking back the the above examples, all of these facts should be believable.
segments.translation: 위의 예제들을 돌이켜 보면, 이 사실들은 모두 수긍이 갈 것입니다.

segments.source: Facts about Orthogonal Complements
Let <m>W</m> be a subspace of <m>\R^n</m>.
Then:
<m>W^\perp</m> is also a subspace of <m>\R^n.</m>
For the first assertion, we verify the three <xref ref="subspaces-defn-of" text="title">defining properties of subspaces</xref>.
segments.translation: 첫 번째 주장을 위해, 세 가지 <xref ref="subspaces-defn-of" text="title">부분공간의 정의 성질</xref>을 확인합니다.

segments.source: The zero vector is in <m>W^\perp</m> because the zero vector is orthogonal to every vector in <m>\R^n</m>.
Let <m>u,v</m> be in <m>W^\perp</m>, so <m>u\cdot x = 0</m> and <m>v\cdot x = 0</m> for every vector <m>x</m> in <m>W</m>.
segments.translation: <m>u,v</m>가 <m>W^\perp</m>에 속한다고 하면, <m>W</m>의 모든 벡터 <m>x</m>에 대해 <m>u\cdot x = 0</m>이고 <m>v\cdot x = 0</m>입니다.

segments.source: We must verify that <m>(u+v)\cdot x = 0</m> for every <m>x</m> in <m>W</m>.

Indeed, we have
            <me>(u+v)\cdot x = u\cdot x + v\cdot x = 0 + 0 = 0.</me>
segments.translation: 실제로 다음이 성립합니다. <me>(u+v)\cdot x = u\cdot x + v\cdot x = 0 + 0 = 0.</me>

segments.source: Let <m>u</m> be in <m>W^\perp</m>, so <m>u\cdot x = 0</m> for every <m>x</m> in <m>W</m>, and let <m>c</m> be a scalar.
segments.translation: <m>u</m>가 <m>W^\perp</m>에 속한다고 하면 <m>W</m>의 모든 <m>x</m>에 대해 <m>u\cdot x = 0</m>이며, <m>c</m>를 스칼라라고 합시다.

segments.source: We must verify that <m>(cu)\cdot x = 0</m> for every <m>x</m> in <m>W</m>.

Indeed, we have
            <me>(cu)\cdot x = c(u\cdot x) = c0 = 0.</me>
segments.translation: 실제로 다음이 성립합니다. <me>(cu)\cdot x = c(u\cdot x) = c0 = 0.</me>

segments.source: Next we prove the third assertion.
Let <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m</m> be a basis for <m>W</m>, so <m>m = \dim(W)</m>, and let <m>v_{m+1},v_{m+2},\ldots,v_k</m> be a basis for <m>W^\perp</m>, so <m>k-m = \dim(W^\perp)</m>.
We need to show <m>k=n</m>.
First we claim that <m>\{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m,v_{m+1},v_{m+2},\ldots,v_k\}</m> is linearly independent.
Suppose that <m>c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_kv_k = 0</m>.
Let <m>w = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m</m> and <m>w' = c_{m+1}v_{m+1} + c_{m+2}v_{m+2} + \cdots + c_kv_k</m>, so <m>w</m> is in <m>W</m>, <m>w'</m> is in <m>W'</m>, and <m>w + w' = 0</m>.
segments.translation: <m>w = c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_mv_m</m>, <m>w' = c_{m+1}v_{m+1} + c_{m+2}v_{m+2} + \cdots + c_kv_k</m>라 하면, <m>w</m>는 <m>W</m>에 속하고 <m>w'</m>는 <m>W'</m>에 속하며 <m>w + w' = 0</m>입니다.

segments.source: Then w = -w' is in both W and W^\perp, which implies w is perpendicular to itself.
In particular, <m>w\cdot w = 0</m>, so <m>w = 0</m>, and hence <m>w' = 0</m>.
Therefore, all coefficients <m>c_i</m> are equal to zero, because <m>\{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m\}</m> and <m>\{v_{m+1},v_{m+2},\ldots,v_k\}</m> are linearly independent.
It follows from the previous paragraph that <m>k \leq n</m>.
Suppose that <m>k \lt n</m>.
Let <m>x</m> be a nonzero vector in <m>\Nul(A)</m>.

Since <m>v_1\cdot x = v_2\cdot x = \cdots = v_m\cdot x = 0</m>, it follows from this <xref ref="orthocomp-comp-of-span"/> that <m>x</m> is in <m>W^\perp</m>, and similarly, <m>x</m> is in <m>(W^\perp)^\perp</m>.
segments.translation: <m>v_1\cdot x = v_2\cdot x = \cdots = v_m\cdot x = 0</m>이므로 이 <xref ref="orthocomp-comp-of-span"/>로부터 <m>x</m>는 <m>W^\perp</m>에 속하고, 마찬가지로 <m>x</m>는 <m>(W^\perp)^\perp</m>에 속합니다.

segments.source: As above, this implies <m>x</m> is orthogonal to itself, which contradicts our assumption that <m>x</m> is nonzero.
segments.translation: 앞에서와 같이 이는 <m>x</m>가 자기 자신과 직교함을 뜻하며, 이는 <m>x</m>가 영이 아니라는 가정에 모순입니다.

segments.source: Therefore, <m>k = n</m>, as desired.
Finally, we prove the second assertion.
Clearly <m>W</m> is contained in <m>(W^\perp)^\perp</m>: this says that everything in <m>W</m> is perpendicular to the set of all vectors perpendicular to everything in <m>W</m>.
segments.translation: <m>W</m>가 <m>(W^\perp)^\perp</m>에 포함됨은 분명합니다. 이는 <m>W</m>의 모든 원소가, <m>W</m>의 모든 원소에 수직인 벡터 전체의 집합에 수직이라는 뜻입니다.

segments.source: Let <m>m=\dim(W).</m>
By 3, we have <m>\dim(W^\perp) = n-m</m>, so <m>\dim((W^\perp)^\perp) = n - (n-m) = m</m>.
The only <m>m</m>-dimensional subspace of <m>(W^\perp)^\perp</m> is all of <m>(W^\perp)^\perp</m>, so <m>(W^\perp)^\perp = W.</m>
See these <xref lower="true" ref="orthocomp-pictures"/> for pictures of the second property.
segments.translation: 두 번째 성질을 나타낸 그림은 이 <xref lower="true" ref="orthocomp-pictures"/>을 참고하십시오.

segments.source: As for the third: for example, if <m>W</m> is a (<m>2</m>-dimensional) plane in <m>\R^4</m>, then <m>W^\perp</m> is another (<m>2</m>-dimensional) plane.
segments.translation: 세 번째 성질에 대해서는, 예를 들어 <m>W</m>가 <m>\R^4</m> 안의 (<m>2</m>차원) 평면이면 <m>W^\perp</m>는 또 다른 (<m>2</m>차원) 평면입니다.

segments.source: Row space of a matrix
The <term>row space</term> of a matrix <m>A</m> is the span of the rows of <m>A</m>, and is denoted <m>\Row(A)</m>.

<idx><h>Row space</h><h>is column space of transpose</h></idx>
    <idx><h>Column space</h><h>is row space of transpose</h></idx>
    If <m>A</m> is an <m>m\times n</m> matrix, then the rows of <m>A</m> are vectors with <m>n</m> entries, so <m>\Row(A)</m> is a subspace of <m>\R^n</m>.
segments.translation: <idx><h>Row space</h><h>is column space of transpose</h></idx> <idx><h>Column space</h><h>is row space of transpose</h></idx> <m>A</m>가 <m>m\times n</m> 행렬이면 <m>A</m>의 행은 성분이 <m>n</m>개인 벡터이므로, <m>\Row(A)</m>는 <m>\R^n</m>의 부분공간입니다.

segments.source:
Equivalently, since the rows of <m>A</m> are the columns of <m>A^T</m>, the row space of <m>A</m> is the column space of <m>A^T</m>:
    <me>\Row(A) = \Col(A^T).</me>

We showed in the above <xref ref="orthocomp-comp-of-span"/> that if <m>A</m> has rows <m>v_1^T,v_2^T,\ldots,v_m^T</m>, then
    <me>\Row(A)^\perp = \Span\{v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_m\}^\perp = \Nul(A).</me>

Taking orthogonal complements of both sides and using the <xref ref="orthocomp-facts-basic">second fact</xref> gives
    <me>\Row(A) = \Nul(A)^\perp.</me>
segments.translation: 양변의 직교여공간을 취하고 <xref ref="orthocomp-facts-basic">두 번째 사실</xref>을 이용하면 <me>\Row(A) = \Nul(A)^\perp.</me>를 얻습니다.

segments.source:
Replacing <m>A</m> by <m>A^T</m> and remembering that <m>\Row(A)=\Col(A^T)</m> gives
    <me>\Col(A)^\perp = \Nul(A^T) \sptxt{and} \Col(A) = \Nul(A^T)^\perp.</me>
To summarize:
Recipes: Shortcuts for computing orthogonal complements

For any matrix <m>A</m>, we have
      <me>
        \begin{aligned}
          \Row(A)^\perp &= \Nul(A)    &  \Nul(A)^\perp &= \Row(A) \\
          \Col(A)^\perp &= \Nul(A^T)\quad  &  \Nul(A^T)^\perp &= \Col(A).
        \end{aligned}
      </me>

As mentioned in the beginning of this subsection, in order to compute the orthogonal complement of a general subspace, usually it is best to rewrite the subspace as the column space or null space of a matrix.
segments.translation: 이 소절의 처음에 언급했듯이, 일반적인 부분공간의 직교여공간을 계산하려면 대개 그 부분공간을 어떤 행렬의 열공간이나 영공간으로 다시 쓰는 것이 가장 좋습니다.

segments.source: Orthogonal complement of a subspace

Compute the orthogonal complement of the subspace
        <me>
          W = \bigl\{(x,y,z) \text{ in } \R^3\mid 3x + 2y = z\bigr\}.
        </me>
segments.translation:
부분공간 <me>
          W = \bigl\{(x,y,z) \text{ in } \R^3\mid 3x + 2y = z\bigr\}.
        </me>의 직교여공간을 계산하십시오.

segments.source: Rewriting, we see that <m>W</m> is the solution set of the system of equations <m>3x + 2y - z = 0</m>, i.e., the null space of the matrix <m>A = \mat{3 2 -1}.</m>
segments.translation: 다시 쓰면 <m>W</m>는 연립방정식 <m>3x + 2y - z = 0</m>의 해집합, 즉 행렬 <m>A = \mat{3 2 -1}.</m>의 영공간임을 알 수 있습니다.

segments.source:
Therefore,
        <me>
          W^\perp = \Row(A) = \Span\left\{\vec{3 2 -1}\right\}.
        </me>
No row reduction was needed!
Orthogonal complement of an eigenspace

Find the orthogonal complement of the <m>5</m>-eigenspace of the matrix
        <me>
          A = \mat{2 4 -1; 3 2 0; -2 4 3}.
        </me>

The <m>5</m>-eigenspace is
        <me>W = \Nul(A - 5I_3) = \Nul\mat{-3 4 -1; 3 -3 0; -2 4 -2},</me>
        so
        <me>
          W^\perp = \Row\mat{-3 4 -1; 3 -3 0; -2 4 -2}
          = \Span\left\{\vec{-3 4 -1},\;\vec{3 -3 0},\;\vec{-2 4 -2}\right\}.
        </me>
These vectors are necessarily linearly dependent (why)?
Row rank and column rank
Suppose that <m>A</m> is an <m>m \times n</m> matrix.

Let us refer to the dimensions of <m>\Col(A)</m> and <m>\Row(A)</m> as the <term>row rank</term> and the <term>column rank</term> of <m>A</m> (note that the column rank of <m>A</m> is the same as the rank of <m>A</m>).
segments.translation: <m>\Col(A)</m>와 <m>\Row(A)</m>의 차원을 각각 <m>A</m>의 <term>행 랭크</term>와 <term>열 랭크</term>라고 부릅시다(<m>A</m>의 열 랭크는 <m>A</m>의 랭크와 같다는 점에 유의하십시오).

segments.source: The next theorem says that the row and column ranks are the same.
segments.translation: 다음 정리는 행 랭크와 열 랭크가 같다는 것을 말해 줍니다.

segments.source: This is surprising for a couple of reasons.
segments.translation: 이는 몇 가지 이유에서 놀라운 사실입니다.

segments.source: First, <m>\Row(A)</m> lies in <m>\R^n</m> and <m>\Col(A)</m> lies in <m>\R^m</m>.

Also, the theorem implies that <m>A</m> and <m>A^T</m> have the same number of pivots, even though the reduced row echelon forms of <m>A</m> and <m>A^T</m> have nothing to do with each other otherwise.
segments.translation: 또한 이 정리에 따르면 <m>A</m>와 <m>A^T</m>의 기약 행 사다리꼴은 그 외에는 서로 아무 관련이 없는데도 <m>A</m>와 <m>A^T</m>는 같은 개수의 피벗을 가집니다.

segments.source: Let <m>A</m> be a matrix.
Then the row rank of <m>A</m> is equal to the column rank of <m>A</m>.
segments.translation: 그러면 <m>A</m>의 행 랭크는 <m>A</m>의 열 랭크와 같습니다.

segments.source:
By the <xref ref="rank-theorem"/>, we have
      <me>
        \dim\Col(A) + \dim\Nul(A) = n.
      </me>

On the other hand the <xref ref="orthocomp-facts-basic">third fact</xref> says that
      <me>
        \dim\Nul(A)^\perp + \dim\Nul(A) = n,
      </me>
      which implies <m>\dim\Col(A) = \dim\Nul(A)^\perp</m>.
segments.translation:
한편 <xref ref="orthocomp-facts-basic">세 번째 사실</xref>에 따르면 <me>
        \dim\Nul(A)^\perp + \dim\Nul(A) = n,
      </me>이고, 이로부터 <m>\dim\Col(A) = \dim\Nul(A)^\perp</m>가 성립합니다.

segments.source:
Since <m>\Nul(A)^\perp = \Row(A),</m> we have
      <me>\dim\Col(A) = \dim\Row(A)</me>,
as desired.
In particular, by this <xref ref="dimension-basis-colspace-dim"/> both the row rank and the column rank are equal to the number of pivots of <m>A</m>.
segments.translation: 특히, 이 <xref ref="dimension-basis-colspace-dim"/>에 의해 행 랭크와 열 랭크는 모두 <m>A</m>의 피벗 개수와 같습니다.
